structured_summary: A NAO robot delivers a package to a recipient. Upon arrival, the robot announces the package and asks for receipt confirmation. The recipient must acknowledge within 10 seconds. After receiving acknowledgement, the robot must confirm successful delivery within 2 seconds. The robot must not interrupt the recipient while speaking. If no acknowledgement within 10 seconds, the robot may repeat the request once. If still no response after retry, the interaction fails. The interaction is successful if the robot announces, recipient acknowledges, and robot confirms. It is unsuccessful if the robot interrupts, recipient does not respond after retry, robot fails to confirm after acknowledgement, or any timing constraint is violated. The entire interaction must finish within 30 seconds from the initial announcement.

obligations.source_sentence: When the robot arrives at the delivery location, it announces that a package has arrived and asks the recipient to confirm receipt.
The recipient should acknowledge the delivery within 10 seconds.
After receiving the acknowledgement, the robot must confirm the successful delivery within 2 seconds.
The robot must not interrupt the recipient while the recipient is speaking.
If no acknowledgement is received within 10 seconds, the robot may repeat the delivery request once.
If the recipient still does not respond after the retry, the delivery interaction fails.
The complete interaction must finish within 30 seconds from the initial delivery announcement.
